text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pandora-san! Please become a princess with 
me!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Whoa whoa, what's with this all of 
a sudden~?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Did you know, Pandora-san? The student 
council is currently accepting proposals 
for a kids' event!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It came to me in a flash. A performance 
that captures children's hearts is none 
other than a story like PuriFi!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In that case, with our own hands, I've 
decided we shall put on a princess hero 
show that everyone admires, just like 
PuriFi~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~ that sounds super great! I can 
totally captivate all~ the little kids, 
y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Teaming up with you, a fellow PuriFi 
lover, makes us invincible! It will 
definitely be a roaring success~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The kind of princess I wish to portray! 
One who rises back up with pure guts even 
after getting battered and bruised! That 
is the one thing I simply cannot 
compromise on...!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeehhh~! I think being super sparkly is 
way better than being battered and 
bruised~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wearing gorgeous outfits and defeating bad 
guys with ultra-flashy special moves! Omg, 
it'll look so totally photogenic~♡

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I understand that sentiment perfectly 
well! A gracefully shining princess is 
wonderful too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
However, this time! Covered in mud, yet 
unbreakable in spirit... That is the royal 
beauty I want to show!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... But still! An princess fighting in 
super-sparkly costumes is just the 
absolute best, right, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...! What in the world should we 
do~~~?! Even though we both love PuriFi 
just as much, for our visions to clash 
like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(...Come to think of it, back on that day 
too—)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
('The shapes of our admiration may 
differ'—)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Yet we both love the same PuriFi, and 
were enchanted by it in the exact same 
way—)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's it...! I've made up my mind, 
Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Neither of us needs to compromise! We 
should just pack every single bit of our 
ideals into it~!

Today is the day of the kids' event hosted 
by Tracen Academy. While watching the 
stage performance...

text_block_list.name: 'Pure Princess'
text_block_list.text: *Pant*... *pant*...! Not yet! Hyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: 'Dark Queen'
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! You couldn't even graze me. Take 
this—'Dark Rouge'!

text_block_list.name: 'Pure Princess'
text_block_list.text: Kuh, kyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: 'Pure Princess'
text_block_list.text:
...This is... nothing... As if I would 
ever give up...!

text_block_list.name: 'Pure Princess'
text_block_list.text:
A true princess always rises back up, no 
matter the dire predicament!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child A
text_block_list.text:
Ahh...! Even though she's all beaten 
up...! You can do it, Princess~!

Sorry to keep you waiting, Princess-chan~☆ 
—Toh♪

text_block_list.name: 'Luminous Pandora'
text_block_list.text:
Everything's fine now! —Hyah, Luminous 
Puuunch☆

text_block_list.name: 'Dark Queen'
text_block_list.text: Gwaaah...! Damn you, who are youuu...?!

text_block_list.name: 'Luminous Pandora'
text_block_list.text:
Luminous Pandora has arrived~! I'll take 
down the bad guys in a snap, so don't 
worry♡

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child B
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Pandora-chan is so pretty~! Go for 
it, don't lose~!

text_block_list.name: 'Pure Princess'
text_block_list.text:
Pandora-san...! Yes! Let us unite our 
princess powers right here!

text_block_list.name: 'Pure Princess'
text_block_list.text:
A mighty fist and a pure heart! Pure 
Princess!

text_block_list.name: 'Luminous Pandora'
text_block_list.text:
Sparkle bright, light of hope♪ Luminous 
Pandora☆

text_block_list.name: 'Pure Princess'
text_block_list.text:
Feast your eyes upon— Our ultimate special 
move!

text_block_list.name: Princess & Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...! 'Princess Hope Stream'!!

It was a show brimming with passion... 
While feeling deeply moved, I spotted the 
two lead stars stepping off the stage.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Senpai, you're crazy amazing~. 
Packing everything both of us wanted into 
it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! The shapes of our admiration may be 
different, after all. ...Yet that is 
perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For every form of admiration, there exists 
an ideal princess! Because our feelings of 
dreaming about princesses are one and the 
same!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, it's Pure Princess! Hey hey, 
getting back up even when you were almost 
beaten... was super duper cool!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child B
text_block_list.text:
I like Luminous Pandora best~! She's super 
strong, and she sparkles! I wanna be just 
like her one day~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡ Thanks a bunch~! Looks like eve~ryone 
is totally crazy about us☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is our absolute honor~! ...We truly 
shone out there, didn't we? Just like the 
princesses we've always admired!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
With a reception like this, a part two is 
definitely on the table! We'll have to 
consider adding even more princesses next 
time... Oh, my blood is simply boiling 
with excitement~!
